The position will play a crucial role in the development, maintenance, and improvement of the software tools involved in the commissioning process from initial power-on through integration, phased bring-up, component and system testing, benchmarking, and acceptance testing to hand-over to operations. These tools are used by internal teams, partners, and vendors working together to transform physically built infrastructure into a production-ready platform. This role involves custom tool development, integration with a wide variety of other closed-source and open-source tools, cloud services, and SaaS platforms. We are deploying leading edge AI Factory technology and the tools supporting the commissioning process are critical for successful on-time delivery. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI technology and contribute to the growth of AI infrastructure. System and status monitoring Work with vendors to implement, configure, and adapt system and status monitoring tools suitable for implementation early in the commissioning phase. Network tools Commissioning of the network also requires suitable tools and processes, which need to be automated and streamlined. In close collaboration with the networking team, vendors, and partners implement suitable tools and an efficient process from initial power-on and OS deployment to firmware updates and network configuration. Storage Develop tooling and automation frameworks supporting deployment, configuration, benchmarking, and validation of storage platforms. Communication tools Efficient and effective communication between various teams involved in the commissioning process needs to be supported by suitable tools. Integrate messaging tools, inventory databases, component trackers, issue trackers, time and resource trackers, reporting platforms, dashboards, and operational analytics to avoid duplication and support a fast, reliable, and repeatable commissioning process. Testing and benchmarking Develop test and benchmarking tools, customise them for the specific project and customer requirements, and execute the tests to confirm the successful completion of the commissioning process. Automation and documentation Leverage modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools to simulate, automate and accelerate the commissioning process. Implement CI/CD pipelines for tool and configuration changes to improve speed, consistency, and auditability. Automate repeatable tasks, document the tools and processes, and prepare them for hand-over to operations teams. Security In all tools and throughout the deployment process implement best security practices including security updates and patches, secure handling of credentials, keys, and secrets, secure system setup, network and storage configurations. Successful automation of repeatable deployment activities. Effective monitoring and diagnostic coverage. Accurate documentation and operational handover. Reduction in manual effort and deployment errors. Experience in Linux systems including server, network, and storage configuration. Experience developing production software tools and APIs, consuming and integrating REST APIs, applying modern software development practices, building automated testing frameworks. Experience using scripting, automation, and IaC tools including bash, Python, Ansible. Location & Reporting This role is based in Australia or Singapore with regular visits to current and future project sites in Australia and SE Asia. review_candidates.description: Job Description Execute end to end client events in our Miami office As an Associate Event Planner within our Latin America J.P. Morgan Private Bank Events team, you will execute client events end-to-end, from concept and planning through onsite delivery and post-event reporting. You will manage multiple programs simultaneously (large-scale events, intimate dinners/round tables, and sports & entertainment allocations) while ensuring brand-standard experiences, disciplined budget and process execution, and high-quality event data and ROI reporting through the firm's events management platform. Partnering closely with the Global Events Team, bankers, product partners, and senior management, you will help deliver distinctive client experiences that support our business strategies and deepen client relationships. This high-pressure role requires strong communication skills, accuracy, long hours, extensive regional travel, and robust data management capabilities. Based in Miami, this position reports to the Head of Latin America Private Bank Events. Based in Miami, this role reports to the Head of Latin America Private Bank Events. Job Responsibilities Support market event strategy by translating business objectives into event plans and timelines. Manage end-to-end logistics (venues, catering, AV, travel, materials) and maintain detailed project plans across concurrent events. Own event setup and data integrity in the events management platform, including RSVP management, attendee communications, and post-event ROI reporting. Track budgets and managing event-related operational processes (POs, contracts, invoices, vendor onboarding) in line with required controls. Build and deploy client communications (invites, reminders, confirmations, thank-you notes) using approved templates and channels. Coordinate guest experience details (invitation lists, seating, badges, onsite check-in/registration). Lead onsite execution support (room setup, vendor management, speaker support, AV and presentation checks). Produce concise pre- and post-event materials (briefing notes, status updates, attendance/feedback/cost summaries, lessons learned). Contribute to process improvements and special projects, with an emphasis on efficiency and consistency across the market. Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities 6+ years of hands-on event planning experience (multi-event, high-touch client environment). Fluency in Portuguese and or Spanish (spoken and written) required. Solid project management experience and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams with strong attention to detail and sound judgment with confidential information. Familiarity with key Latin America cities/venues/vendors and cultural nuances. Willingness to travel internationally and support occasional extended hours during peak event periods. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and SharePoint. Financial services experience .
